title: Bestsad Primitive Record, SRE v0.1 extension
description: Extends the delivered v0.2 primitive record with the CANONICAL maturity state and the two fields that license it. The delivered schemas/primitive_record.schema.json is pinned in MANIFEST_SHA256.txt and is NOT edited (CONTRIBUTING.md, spec §31.1); a record using CANONICAL validates against this schema instead. See ADR 0017.

maturity.description: The v0.2 states plus CANONICAL, which sits between VER and CORE.

semantic_signature.description: Recovered semantic signature this primitive's identity is pinned to. Bare 64-character hex, matching BestSad's native digest convention (ADR 0015).

equivalence_verdict.description: Tier of the evidence binding the signature to the primitive's K0 expansion. Only EQUIV_CANONICAL licenses the CANONICAL maturity state.

then.description: CANONICAL is unreachable without a canonical-tier proof. The schema enforces this independently of the promotion code, so a hand-written record cannot claim the state either.
